```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(randomForest)
library(whychusModel)
```

# Configuration

```{r config}
month_start   <- 5      # May
month_end     <- 9      # September
lead_days_vec <- c(1, 3, 7)   # forecast horizons to model

ntree <- 500            # number of trees
p     <- 0.2            # test proportion (fraction held out)
mtry  <- NULL           # NULL = default floor(p/3)

output_dir <- here::here("output")
```

# 1. Load Data

## 1a. RM 8.5 daily max temperature

```{r rm85-tmax}
rm85_tmax <- rm_8_5_historical |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(statistic == "max") |>
  select(date, rm_8_5_tmax = temperature)
```

## 1b. RM 8.5 7-day average daily maximum (7DADM)

```{r rm85-7dadm}
rm85_7dadm <- rm_8_5_historical |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(statistic == "7DADM") |>
  select(date, rm_8_5_7dadm = temperature)
```

## 1c. Camp Polk temperature

```{r camp-polk-temp}
cp_temp <- camp_polk_temperature_historical |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(statistic == "max") |>
  select(date, cp_tmax = temperature)

cp_7dadm <- camp_polk_temperature_historical |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(statistic == "7DADM") |>
  select(date, cp_7dadm = temperature)
```

## 1d. Camp Polk flow

```{r camp-polk-flow}
cp_flow <- camp_polk_flow_historical |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(statistic == "mean") |>
  select(date, cp_flow_mean = flow_cfs)
```

# 2. Helper Functions

```{r helpers}
get_forecast <- function(lead_k) {
  fcst <- all_historical_forecasts |>
    filter(lead_days == lead_k) |>
    select(valid_date, variable, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) |>
    rename(date = valid_date,
           air_max   = temperature_2m_max,
           air_min   = temperature_2m_min,
           cloud_pct = cloud_cover_mean)

  obs <- all_historical_forecasts |>
    filter(lead_days == 0) |>
    select(valid_date, variable, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) |>
    rename(date = valid_date,
           air_max   = temperature_2m_max,
           air_min   = temperature_2m_min,
           cloud_pct = cloud_cover_mean)

  bind_rows(fcst, obs) |>
    distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

build_df <- function(lead_k, target_tbl = rm85_tmax, target_col = "rm_8_5_tmax",
                     cp_temp_tbl = cp_temp, cp_temp_col = "cp_tmax") {
  fcst_k <- get_forecast(lead_k)

  target_tbl |>
    left_join(cp_flow,     by = "date") |>
    left_join(cp_temp_tbl, by = "date") |>
    left_join(fcst_k,      by = "date") |>
    mutate(
      month  = month(date),
      Julian = yday(date),
      year   = year(date)
    ) |>
    filter(month >= month_start, month <= month_end) |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[target_col]]), !is.na(cp_flow_mean),
           !is.na(air_max), !is.na(.data[[cp_temp_col]])) |>
    drop_na() |>
    distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    arrange(date)
}

fit_rf <- function(X, tar, dates, ntree = 500, mtry = NULL, p = 0.2, seed = 42) {
  X  <- as.data.frame(lapply(X, as.numeric))
  ok <- complete.cases(X) & is.finite(tar)
  X  <- X[ok, ]; tar <- tar[ok]; dates <- dates[ok]

  set.seed(seed)
  train_idx  <- sort(sample(nrow(X), floor(nrow(X) * (1 - p))))
  test_idx   <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(X)), train_idx)

  X_train    <- X[train_idx, ];  X_test <- X[test_idx, ]
  y_train    <- tar[train_idx];  y_test  <- tar[test_idx]
  dates_test <- dates[test_idx]

  train_df        <- X_train
  train_df$target <- y_train
  rf_mtry         <- if (is.null(mtry)) max(1, floor(ncol(X) / 3)) else mtry

  set.seed(seed)
  model <- randomForest(
    formula    = as.formula(paste("target ~", paste(names(X), collapse = " + "))),
    data       = train_df,
    ntree      = ntree,
    mtry       = rf_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  y_pred <- predict(model, X_test)
  SSres  <- sum((y_pred - y_test)^2)
  SStot  <- sum((y_test  - mean(y_test))^2)

  list(
    model      = model,
    y_pred     = y_pred,
    y_test     = y_test,
    dates_test = dates_test,
    R2         = 1 - SSres / SStot,
    RMSE       = sqrt(SSres / length(y_pred)),
    MAE        = mean(abs(y_pred - y_test)),
    n_train    = nrow(X_train),
    n_test     = nrow(X_test),
    n_features = ncol(X),
    mtry       = rf_mtry
  )
}
```

---

# Section A — No Lag

**Features:** `cp_flow_mean`, `cp_tmax`, `Julian`, `air_max`, `air_min`, `cloud_pct`

```{r section-a}
base_features <- c("cp_flow_mean", "cp_tmax", "Julian", "air_max", "air_min", "cloud_pct")

fits_A <- map(lead_days_vec, function(k) {
  df <- build_df(k)
  X  <- df |> select(all_of(base_features))
  fit_rf(X, df$rm_8_5_tmax, df$date, ntree = ntree, mtry = mtry, p = p)
})
names(fits_A) <- paste0("lead_", lead_days_vec)

results_A <- map2_dfr(fits_A, lead_days_vec, ~ tibble(
  target     = "tmax",
  section    = "A_no_lag",
  lead_day   = .y,
  R2         = .x$R2,
  RMSE       = .x$RMSE,
  MAE        = .x$MAE,
  n_features = .x$n_features,
  mtry       = .x$mtry,
  n_train    = .x$n_train,
  n_test     = .x$n_test
))

print(results_A)
```

## Section A — Predicted vs Observed (all leads)

```{r plot-a-pred}
map2_dfr(fits_A, lead_days_vec, ~ tibble(
  lead_day = .y, predicted = .x$y_pred, observed = .x$y_test
)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = predicted, y = observed)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#185FA5", size = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "#E24B4A",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~paste("Lead:", lead_day, "days"), nrow = 2) +
  labs(title = "Section A (No Lag) — Predicted vs Observed",
       x = "Predicted (°C)", y = "Observed (°C)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Section A — Variable Importance (lead 1)

```{r plot-a-imp}
as.data.frame(importance(fits_A$lead_1$model)) |>
  rownames_to_column("feature") |>
  arrange(desc(`%IncMSE`)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(feature, `%IncMSE`), y = `%IncMSE`)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#185FA5") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Section A — Variable Importance, Lead 1 (%IncMSE)",
       x = NULL, y = "% Increase in MSE") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# Section B — Predictor Lag (t−1)

**Added features:** `cp_flow_m1`, `cp_tmax_m1`, `air_max_m1`, `air_min_m1`

```{r section-b}
fits_B <- map(lead_days_vec, function(k) {
  df <- build_df(k)
  n  <- nrow(df)

  current <- df |> slice(2:n)
  lagged  <- df |> slice(1:(n - 1))

  X <- tibble(
    cp_flow_mean = current$cp_flow_mean,
    cp_tmax      = current$cp_tmax,
    Julian       = current$Julian,
    air_max      = current$air_max,
    air_min      = current$air_min,
    cloud_pct    = current$cloud_pct,
    cp_flow_m1   = lagged$cp_flow_mean,
    cp_tmax_m1   = lagged$cp_tmax,
    air_max_m1   = lagged$air_max,
    air_min_m1   = lagged$air_min
  )

  fit_rf(X, current$rm_8_5_tmax, current$date, ntree = ntree, mtry = mtry, p = p)
})
names(fits_B) <- paste0("lead_", lead_days_vec)

results_B <- map2_dfr(fits_B, lead_days_vec, ~ tibble(
  target     = "tmax",
  section    = "B_pred_lag",
  lead_day   = .y,
  R2         = .x$R2,
  RMSE       = .x$RMSE,
  MAE        = .x$MAE,
  n_features = .x$n_features,
  mtry       = .x$mtry,
  n_train    = .x$n_train,
  n_test     = .x$n_test
))

print(results_B)
```

# Results Comparison

```{r comparison}
all_results <- bind_rows(results_A, results_B, results_C,
                         results_D, results_E, results_F)

section_colors <- c(
  A_no_lag = "#185FA5", B_pred_lag = "#E87722", C_pred_tar_lag = "#74A089",
  D_no_lag = "#185FA5", E_pred_lag = "#E87722", F_pred_tar_lag = "#74A089"
)
section_labels <- c(
  A_no_lag = "No lag", B_pred_lag = "Predictor lag", C_pred_tar_lag = "Pred + target lag",
  D_no_lag = "No lag", E_pred_lag = "Predictor lag", F_pred_tar_lag = "Pred + target lag"
)

ggplot(all_results, aes(x = lead_day, y = R2, color = section, group = section)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~target, labeller = labeller(target = c(tmax = "Max Temperature", `7dadm` = "7DADM"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = section_colors, labels = section_labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = lead_days_vec) +
  labs(title = "RF R² by Forecast Lead — RM 8.5",
       x = "Forecast Lead (days)", y = "R²") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggplot(all_results, aes(x = lead_day, y = RMSE, color = section, group = section)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~target, labeller = labeller(target = c(tmax = "Max Temperature", `7dadm` = "7DADM"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = section_colors, labels = section_labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = lead_days_vec) +
  labs(title = "RF RMSE by Forecast Lead — RM 8.5",
       x = "Forecast Lead (days)", y = "RMSE (°C)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

all_results |>
  mutate(across(c(R2, RMSE, MAE), ~ round(.x, 4))) |>
  arrange(target, section, lead_day) |>
  print(n = Inf)

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(all_results, file.path(output_dir, "rm85_rf_results.csv"))
cat("Results saved to:", file.path(output_dir, "rm85_rf_results.csv"), "\n")
```

# Diagnostics

Select target, section, and lead day to inspect in detail.

```{r diag-setup}
best_target  <- "tmax"             # "tmax" or "7dadm"
best_section <- "C_pred_tar_lag"   # tmax: A/B/C  |  7dadm: D/E/F
best_lead    <- lead_days_vec[1]

fits_list <- list(
  A_no_lag       = fits_A,
  B_pred_lag     = fits_B,
  C_pred_tar_lag = fits_C,
  D_no_lag       = fits_D,
  E_pred_lag     = fits_E,
  F_pred_tar_lag = fits_F
)
best_fit <- fits_list[[best_section]][[paste0("lead_", best_lead)]]
```

## Residuals vs Predicted

```{r diag-residuals}
tibble(
  predicted = best_fit$y_pred,
  observed  = best_fit$y_test,
  residual  = best_fit$y_test - best_fit$y_pred
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = predicted, y = residual)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#185FA5", size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#E24B4A", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Residuals vs Predicted — %s | Lead %d", best_section, best_lead),
    x = "Predicted rm_8_5_tmax (°C)", y = "Residual (obs − pred, °C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Residual Distribution

```{r diag-resid-hist}
resid_vec <- best_fit$y_test - best_fit$y_pred

tibble(residual = resid_vec) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = residual)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#185FA5", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#E24B4A", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Residual Distribution — %s | Lead %d | mean = %.3f °C",
                    best_section, best_lead, mean(resid_vec)),
    x = "Residual (obs − pred, °C)", y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Test-Set Time Series

```{r diag-timeseries}
tibble(
  date      = best_fit$dates_test,
  observed  = best_fit$y_test,
  predicted = best_fit$y_pred
) |>
  pivot_longer(c(observed, predicted), names_to = "series", values_to = "temp") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = temp, color = series)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.85, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(observed = "#185FA5", predicted = "#E24B4A"), name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Test-Set Time Series — %s | Lead %d day(s)", best_section, best_lead),
    x = NULL, y = "Max water temp (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## OOB Error vs Number of Trees

```{r diag-oob}
tibble(trees = seq_len(ntree), oob_mse = best_fit$model$mse) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = trees, y = oob_mse)) +
  geom_line(color = "#185FA5", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("OOB MSE by Number of Trees — %s | Lead %d", best_section, best_lead),
    x = "Trees", y = "OOB MSE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Variable Importance — Both Metrics

```{r diag-importance-both}
as.data.frame(importance(best_fit$model)) |>
  rownames_to_column("feature") |>
  pivot_longer(c(`%IncMSE`, IncNodePurity), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(feature, value), y = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_x") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`%IncMSE` = "#185FA5", IncNodePurity = "#74A089")) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Variable Importance — %s | Lead %d", best_section, best_lead),
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Variable Importance Across All Leads

```{r diag-importance-leads}
map2_dfr(fits_list[[best_section]], lead_days_vec, ~ {
  as.data.frame(importance(.x$model)) |>
    rownames_to_column("feature") |>
    mutate(lead_day = .y)
}) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lead_day, y = `%IncMSE`, color = feature, group = feature)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Variable Importance by Lead — %s", best_section),
    x = "Forecast Lead (days)", y = "% Increase in MSE", color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# Save Model

```{r save-model}
tmax_section <- "C_pred_tar_lag"
dadm_section <- "F_pred_tar_lag"

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (k in lead_days_vec) {
  lead_str <- paste0("lead_", k)

  saveRDS(fits_list[[tmax_section]][[lead_str]]$model,
          file.path(output_dir, paste0("rm85_rf_tmax_lead", k, ".rds")))

  saveRDS(fits_list[[dadm_section]][[lead_str]]$model,
          file.path(output_dir, paste0("rm85_rf_7dadm_lead", k, ".rds")))

  cat("Saved: rm85_rf_tmax_lead", k, ".rds  |  rm85_rf_7dadm_lead", k, ".rds\n", sep = "")
}
```
